the seed list from this file; a hardcoded list somewhere else is exactly
the hole this file exists to close.

lands near the decision boundary, append to seeds_phase2 BEFORE running it,
commit that change, and report both phases together -- never phase 2 alone.

choice, so two runs at the same seed still differ. Pairing by seed
therefore removes none of the variance and a paired test would overstate
its power. Treat the arms as independent samples.
